Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Creator uploads a video with metadata (title, tags, location)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gateway authenticates/authorises; load balancer distributes and health-checks

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upload service records details and stores the raw file straight in blob storage first, so reliability is guaranteed

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A queue absorbs bursts of uploads so users are not blocked

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Transcoder workers (one queue per step) produce chunks and device/resolution variants, also compressing to save storage

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Metadata (title, owner, location, tags) goes into a SQL table; schema is fixed, so SQL is fine

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Request carries user id, video id, offset (resume point) and resolution

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Same gateway and load balancer as upload

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Watch service reads device/screen info and chooses the rendition

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Controller checks whether the video is popular and finds the nearest CDN by user location

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On a CDN miss, fetch from the transcoded store and populate the CDN for next time. Adaptive bit-rate (MPEG-DASH style) switches resolution as bandwidth changes

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In parallel with transcoding, metadata is mined for searchable terms

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Extracted keywords are written to a key-value store: keyword → list of video ids

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A search looks up the keyword (fuzzy search handles misspellings, like 'did you mean'); entries ranked by search frequency

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Results are fetched lazily: show the first 10 now, push the rest via a queue as the user scrolls

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Video ids resolve to metadata and playable URLs

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scale: 2B users, 500M DAU × 5 videos = 2.5B views/day; 100M creators × 2 uploads = 200M videos/day × 100 MB = 20 PB/day

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Read-heavy; requirements: high availability, scalability, reliability (uploaded video is never lost), low latency / no buffering

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Left out: likes, comments, dislikes. Replicas and multiple CDNs for scale; a leader CDN as source of truth
